description:
Implement explicit, revisable outgoing attachment selection through attach_documents. Related parent work: zaq-ic9; accepted amendment recorded there on 2026-10-29. Design: https://chatgpt.com/space/page_bdc818e595dc8191ac1712b564afda86

Contract: operation add/remove/replace with Records in and validated Records out. Add deduplicates, removing absent selections is a no-op, replace([]) clears. Full-operation validation precedes atomic mutation. Removal never deletes source documents. GetDocument remains unchanged. Selection success is not delivery.

Trusted runtime context supplies the actual Jido request ID and runtime incarnation, never LLM arguments. One request-scoped authoritative selection survives inference/tool iterations; new requests start empty. Jido state owns selection; StreamEvents transports accepted changes/final snapshot. Fence stale/cross-request effects, deduplicate invocation replay and define deterministic ordering for concurrent conflicting mutations. Failure/cancellation discards selection; successful completion freezes it. Active-request steering can revise selection; later requests cannot retract delivered files.

Carry final selection through StreamEvents, Executor and Pipeline to existing Outgoing.attachments. Channels retains materialization and authorization. No early file delivery, new document catalog, or sensitive Record/effect exposure through traces/history/public tool steps.

Likely production surface: new Action, tools/registry.ex, stream_events.ex, executor.ex, pipeline.ex; Factory/context/effect/alias changes remain discovery-dependent. Outgoing already consumes result.attachments. Do not promise exactly three files.

Implementation is gated by the discovery child. Initial reuse direction: propose generic selection Action; reuse Record/alias authorization and Channels delivery, extend existing runtime/result boundaries. Full reuse assessments and supported Jido integration must be established before coding.

Testing: new unit/integration/property tests for mutation sequences, atomic rejection, authorization, replay/order, lifecycle isolation, privacy and both configured/default delivery paths. Existing test behavior changes require explicit approval. E2E currently not required: this adds no interface and real internal integration plus existing channel delivery coverage can prove the contract deterministically; reassess if discovery identifies an uncovered deployed-interface journey. Any new E2E requires separate human UX approval and dependency gate before authoring.

Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/services/agent.md and docs/testing-approach.md. Documentation belongs in Agent service guide when implemented. Complete validation and post-review coverage handoff before feature closure. No implementation authorized by this issue-creation request.
